newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso ends slightly higher at 1,070.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso ends slightly higher at 1,070.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso edged up 0.5 to close at 1,070.50 per dollar in active trade on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the peso was buoyed, in part, by a large supply of dollars that entered the market from sales by a megastore that was short local currency.
The peso had dropped to an intraday low of 1,077 earlier in the session on what dealers described as a steady wave of dollar-buying by banks.
Dealers reported an above-average 512 trades for US$208 million. ((--Juan Guillermo Londono, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
